title: Sarah Vaughan as one of the guys in the 21-person traveling group
summary: Sarah Vaughan is a thrill to hear nightly and refuses special treatment among seventeen musicians, a valet and management.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: At this point, the band was really beginning to take shape. I was listening to Sarah Vaughan, who it was just a thrill to listen to her every night. Sarah Vaughan was a very unique person to have in a band of seventeen guys. And along

with the seventeen guys, we had a valet, who took care of the drums and the mikes and handling instruments, the bandstands, uniforms, and etcetera. Altogether, our whole group was 21 people, including the manager and Billy. And Sarah was just so unique, because she wasn't like a lot of girls would have been, that you had to treat her different or something like that. She was always one of the guys.
